- centric data engineer to put it to good use. The ideal candidate will have the expected mathematical and statistical expertise, combined with a rare curiosity and creativity. This person will wear many hats in the role, but much of the focus will be on building out our Python ETL processes and writing superb SQL. Beyond technical pro wess, the data engineer will need soft skills for clearly communicating highly complex data trends to organizational leaders. We're looking for someone willing to jump right in and help the company get the most from its data. Objectives of this role Work with data to solve business problems, building and maintaining the infrastructure to answer questions and improve processes Help streamline our data science workflows, adding value to our product offerings and building out the customer lifecycle and retention models Work closely with the data science and business intelligence teams to develop data models and pipelines for research, reporting, and machine learning Be an advocate for best practices and continued learning Responsibilities Work closely with our data science team to help build complex algorithms that provide unique insights into our data Use agile software development processes to make iterative improvements to our back-end systems Model front-end and back-end data sources to help draw a more comprehensive picture of user flows throughout the system and to enable powerful data analysis Build data pipelines that clean, transform, and aggregate data from disparate sources Develop models that can be used to make predictions and answer questions for the overall business Required skills and qualifications Three or more years of experience with Python, SQL, and data visualization/exploration tools Experience in building or maintaining ETL/ELT processes Familiarity with the AWS ecosystem, specifically Redshift and RDS Communication skills, especially for explaining technical concepts to nontechnical business leaders Ability to work on a dynamic, research-oriented team that has concurrent projects Preferred skills and qualifications Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in computer science, information technology, engineering, or related discipline Professional certification

We are seeking an Dev Ops Engineer with 7+ years of experience to join our dynamic and innovative team. As an Dev Ops Engineer, you will work closely with our development, operations, and infrastructure teams to enhance our cloud infrastructure and automate deployment processes. You will primarily be responsible for managing our AWS environment, implementing infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, and maintaining our Kubernetes clusters. Job Description/

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead the design and implementation of cloud infrastructure using AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others, to support our applications and services. Develop and maintain advanced infrastructure as code using Terraform to automate the provisioning and management of AWS resources at scale. Architect and optimize the performance, availability, and cost-effectiveness of our cloud infrastructure, leveraging best practices and innovative solutions. Establish and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines for continuous integration and deployment using industry- leading tools such as Jenkins, Git Lab CI/CD, or AWS Code Pipeline. Collaborate closely with development teams to define and implement best practices for software builds, deployments, and release management in a highly agile environment. Implement comprehensive security measures to protect our infrastructure and applications, including access controls, monitoring, and compliance enforcement. Lead troubleshooting efforts and resolve complex infrastructure and deployment issues promptly to minimize downtime and ensure business continuity. Stay abreast of emerging trends and advancements in Dev Ops, cloud computing, and infrastructure automation, and drive continuous improvement initiatives within the team. Mentor and coach junior members of the team, providing guidance and fostering a culture of learning and professional growth. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of hands-on experience in a Dev Ops Engineer or similar role, with a proven track record of success in designing and managing complex cloud infrastructures./span> Extensive expertise in AWS services, including EKS, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, Cloud Formation, and Cloud Watch. Mastery of infrastructure as code principles and practices, with advanced proficiency in Terraform and a deep understanding of Terraform best practices. Strong command of Kubernetes operations, including deployment, scaling, monitoring, and troubleshooting in production environments. In-depth knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools, such as Jenkins, Git Lab CI/CD, or AWS Code Pipeline, with experience implementing automated deployment pipelines for large-scale applications. Proficient scripting and automation skills using languages such as Python, Bash, or Shell, with a focus on building robust and scalable automation solutions. Solid grasp of networking concepts, security principles, and best practices in cloud environments, with experience implementing and managing security controls and compliance standards. Familiarity with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet is a plus. Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities, with a meticulous attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and addressing technical challenges. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively interact with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a track record of successfully leading and mentoring teams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

We are seeking an Associate Dev Ops Engineer with 2-3 years of experience to join our dynamic and innovative team. As an Associate Dev Ops Engineer, you will work closely with our development, operations, and infrastructure teams to enhance our cloud infrastructure and automate deployment processes. You will primarily be responsible for managing our AWS environment, implementing infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, and maintaining our Kubernetes clusters. Job Description/

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design, deploy, and manage scalable and highly available AWS infrastructure using best practices and AWS services. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand application requirements and develop infrastructure solutions. Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, ensuring version control and documentation. Monitor and optimize the performance, availability, and security of our AWS environment. Automate deployment, configuration, and management tasks using CI/CD pipelines and scripting tools. Implement and manage Kubernetes clusters, including deployment, scaling, and monitoring. Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and deployment issues in a timely manner. Collaborate with developers to streamline the software development lifecycle and improve efficiency. Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in Dev Ops, AWS, Terraform, and Kubernetes. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 2-3 years of experience in Dev Ops or a related field. Strong knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS) and its core services (EKS, EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.). Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform. Proficiency in Kubernetes operations, including deployment, scaling, and monitoring. Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools, such as Jenkins, Git Hub CI/CD, or AWS Code Pipeline. Solid understanding of Linux/Unix operating systems and command-line tools. Strong scripting skills (e.g., Bash, Python, or Power Shell) for automation. Experience with containerization technologies like Docker. Knowledge of networking concepts (VPC, subnets, security groups, etc.) and network troubleshooting. Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within a team.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and logging tools like Cloud Watch, Prometheus, and ELK stack. Experience with configuration management tools like Ansible or Puppet(optional).
